workspaceTitle: Distribute WhatsApp numbers across the team
workspaceDescription: Choose whether each WhatsApp number belongs to one employee only, is auto-distributed across a team, or becomes a shared inbox visible to everyone.
workspaceNumbersDescription: Select a number from the list, then configure its visibility and routing rules.
workspaceNoNumbers: There are no WhatsApp numbers available right now.
workspaceEditorDescription: This page controls who can see chats for this number and who receives new conversations.
workspaceEmptyTitle: Choose a WhatsApp number to begin
workspaceEmptyDescription: Once a number is selected, its routing mode and employee ownership settings will appear here.
modeDirectDescription: All chats, messages, and customer data for this number are visible to one employee only.
modeRoundRobinDescription: The number can be shared by multiple employees, but every new customer chat is automatically assigned to one employee only.
modeSharedInboxDescription: The number is shared by multiple employees, and all employees can see every conversation and message with no isolation.
workspaceEmployeesDirectHint: Select one employee only. They are the only person who will see chats for this number.
workspaceEmployeesRoundRobinHint: Select two or more employees. Each new chat will be assigned to one employee at a time in rotation.
workspaceEmployeesSharedInboxHint: Select one or more employees. All selected employees will see every conversation and message on this number.
privacySummaryIntro: The system blocks other employees from seeing messages, customer data, and chat status when the conversation is not assigned to them.
privacySummaryDirect: In direct assignment mode, the whole number belongs to one employee and nobody else can access its chats.
privacySummaryRoundRobin: In auto-distribution mode, the number can be shared, but every new chat is assigned to one employee only and hidden from the others.
privacySummarySharedInbox: In shared inbox mode, the number is served by multiple employees and everyone sees every conversation and message — no isolation between them.
privacySummaryFooter: This isolation applies to chat lists, customer details, chat status, and realtime notifications.
settingsDescription: Clear, lightweight controls for chat transfers, alerts, and working hours for the WhatsApp team.
settingsOperationsDescription: Set how chats behave inside the team without adding extra complexity.
settingsAllowTransferDescription: Let employees transfer a chat to another employee when needed.
settingsRequireCloseNoteDescription: Force an internal note before a chat can be closed.
settingsAutoCloseDescription: Close a chat automatically after a defined idle period.
settingsDefaultStatus: Default status for a new chat
settingsNotificationsDescription: Choose how the team gets alerted about new chats and transfers.
settingsNotifyNewChatDescription: Send an alert when a new chat reaches an employee.
settingsNotifyTransferDescription: Send an alert when a chat is transferred to another employee.
settingsBrowserPushDescription: Show realtime browser alerts for authorized employees.
settingsSoundEnabledDescription: Play a sound when a new alert arrives.
settingsPolicyDescription: A quick summary of how the system will handle every new conversation.
settingsPrivacyRuleDirect: If a number is linked to one employee, everything related to that number is visible to that employee only.
settingsPrivacyRuleRoundRobin: If a number is shared across multiple employees, every new chat is auto-assigned to one employee only and hidden from the rest.
settingsPrivacyRuleSharedInbox: If a number is in shared inbox mode, all employees see every conversation and message with no isolation.
settingsPolicyFooter: The new pages are designed to reduce complexity and prevent conflicts between permissions and routing rules.
settingsWorkingHoursDescription: Set a working window for the WhatsApp team if you want alerts and follow-up tied to fixed office hours.
settingsWorkingHoursToggleDescription: Use specific days and times for the WhatsApp team.
